title: Sides cut: Opus X, Blowing the Blues Away and a slow blues
summary: The date features Jerry Valentine's Blowing the Blues Away with Ammons and Gordon, and Sarah's ballad I'll Wait and Pray is planned.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: So they wound up recording on that date "Opus X." They recorded a thing that Jerry Valentine wrote which became a very popular piece called "Blowing The Blues Away." And that featured the tenors of Gene Ammons and Dexter Gordon, and of course, there was a Billy Eckstine vocal. The other thing that they recorded was a thing called...
Oh, at the recording date, Jerry Valentine had written a ballad that was called "I'll Wait and Pray." And there was a
vocal for Sarah. That was supposed to have been included, and that would have been Sarah's first record date.

When we get in the studio, we recorded "Opus X," we recorded "Blowing the Blues Away," and another blues that Billy had written, one of those slow blueses, because they were very popular then. So now it's time to record Sarah's tune. By this time they asked us to take a break.
